description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Pantheon''' gains [[File:Armor penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Armor penetration]] armor penetration.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pantheon''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channels]] for 2 seconds before leaping into the sky, causing him to [[File:Hallucinate.png|20px|link=Untargetability#Vanish|An icon representing the keyword Vanish]] [[:Untargetability#Vanish|vanish]] and become [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|immune to crowd control]]. He continues [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channeling]] for 2.25 seconds and grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] around the target location 0.5 seconds into the channel.
description2.text: Active: Pantheon channels for 2 seconds before leaping into the sky, causing him to vanish and become immune to crowd control. He continues channeling for 2.25 seconds and grants sight around the target location 0.5 seconds into the channel.

description3.raw: After 0.8 seconds into the channel, '''Pantheon''' hurls his spear to the target location over 0.2 seconds that deals 40 – 190 (based on [[File:Comet Spear.png|20px|border]] ''Comet Spear's'' rank) (+ 115% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 50% AP) physical damage to enemies near the impact and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them by 50% for 2 seconds.
description3.text: After 0.8 seconds into the channel, Pantheon hurls his spear to the target location over 0.2 seconds that deals 40 – 190 (based on Comet Spear's rank) (+ 115% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP) physical damage to enemies near the impact and slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.

description4.raw: Over the remaining 1.25 seconds, '''Pantheon''' crashes down after 0.55 seconds and creates a shockwave alongside himself that travels toward the target location over 0.7 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit, reduced by up to 50% for those hit at the edge of the area. Upon completion of the channel, '''Pantheon''' will lose the [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|crowd control immunity]] and [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|reappear]] at the target location, as well as gain maximum stacks of ''[[File:Pantheon Mortal Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Pantheon#Mortal Will|An icon for Pantheon's ability Mortal Will]] [[Pantheon#Mortal Will|Mortal Will]]''.
description4.text: Over the remaining 1.25 seconds, Pantheon crashes down after 0.55 seconds and creates a shockwave alongside himself that travels toward the target location over 0.7 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit, reduced by up to 50% for those hit at the edge of the area. Upon completion of the channel, Pantheon will lose the crowd control immunity and reappear at the target location, as well as gain maximum stacks of Mortal Will.

description5.raw: ''Grand Starfall'' is placed on a [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] 30-second cooldown if the first channel is canceled.
description5.text: Grand Starfall is placed on a  30-second cooldown if the first channel is canceled.

notes.text:
Grand Starfall's first channel can be interrupted by cast-inhibiting crowd control, but its second channel cannot because Pantheon gains crowd control immunity during it.
The spear's damage is not empowered by Mortal Will, nor increased against enemies below 20% of their maximum health.
During the second channel, Pantheon gains a minimum health threshold of 1.
* Pantheon will instantly die upon reappearing if he reaches this threshold.
Abilities that target Pantheon will redirect to the last location.
Pinging the ability will inform allies in chat which visible enemy champions are in range of Grand Starfall.
Pantheon is considered to be in his original casting position even after leaping, but he will blink to the target location the moment the second channel completes.
Using Grand Starfall will inform allies with a ping.
If Pantheon leaves the Death Realm during Grand Starfall's shockwave, its hitbox will become invisible but it will still deal damage.(bug)
Experimental Hexplate's Overdrive, Fiendhunter Bolts' Opening Barrage, and Zeke's Convergence's Frostfire Tempest activate at the end of Grand Starfall's second channel, or at the end of the initial channel if it was interrupted.
